descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads in chat while GLM-5.3 outperforms it in coding.
risposta: Gemini 3.8 Flash is ahead in the overall Arena ranking with a chat score of 1497 versus 1482 for GLM-5.3. The blind vote favours Gemini about 52% of the time. However, GLM-5.3 wins the coding category, so the better choice depends on the task.
dimensioni: Gemini 3.8 Flash does not disclose its model size or download size. GLM-5.3 is 753.3 B total, with 50.2 B active parameters, and requires roughly 458 GB to download in 4-bit format.
velocita: Both models need an online connection for generation; none of the listed home GPUs or CPUs can fit the models in memory. The speed estimate therefore lists them as online-only for all hardware.
gratisA: Gemini 3.8 Flash can be accessed for free through Google’s Gemini API free tier. The model is proprietary, so only the API is available at no cost.
gratisB: GLM-5.3 is released under an MIT license with open weights. You can download the model and run it on your own hardware without any charge.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash when you need strong conversational abilities and prefer a cloud-based service. Its higher chat score indicates better performance in general dialogue. The free API makes it easy to integrate into apps.
sceglieB: Choose GLM-5.3 for programming-related tasks, as it leads the coding category with a score of 1623. The open-weight release lets you run it locally if you have sufficient storage. Its MIT license also permits unrestricted use.

categorie.Chat: In the Chat arena Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 1497, edging out GLM-5.3’s 1482. The margin of 15 points translates to a clear lead in conversational quality according to blind human votes.
categorie.Coding: For coding tasks GLM-5.3 achieves a higher score of 1623 compared to Gemini 3.8 Flash’s 1584. This suggests GLM-5.3 provides more accurate or useful code generation in the Arena evaluation.
